label: Finite relative frequency of an event
term: Finite relative frequency of an event
definition: Number of members of the finite set satisfying the event divided by its total cardinality as a real number. The empty-sample value is Lean's total division and irrelevant to the limits here.
note: Analyst mathematical vocabulary in the shared carrier-probability module, reused by the plenitude controls (#2143) and the modal-carrier controls (#2142); no source attribution or metaphysical application is assumed.
